org.name: Birmingham and Solihull Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust

reports.title: Peter Fleming: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: There continues to be a chronic lack of resources to treat seriously mentally ill patients in Birmingham and Solihull
communication between the specialist teams is not effective enough
Carbamazepine management was proposed in 2012 to manage the deceased's mental health however this was not picked up by his GP and was only noted by a BSMHFT consultant in August 2022
different health organisations use different digital systems that do not communicate with each other
current resources do not allow GPs to pro- actively check patients are collecting prescribed medication due to excessive patient lists

reports.title: Matthew Lynch: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

promises.quote: The review acknowledged the risk of relapse identified in May 2023 on page 14, identifying that whilst plans were made within the Multi-disciplinary Team, there was no clear process to track these actions, leading to a lack of oversight. If there had been stronger oversight, the team would have been aware of the non-compliance with medication sooner, allowing for timely intervention. This would have included tracking the perpetrator's prescription. To address this, the team has now implemented a
promises.summary: Implement actions tracker for oversight of agreed plans

concerns.quote: internal investigation did not address how and whether the offender's use of medication should have been monitored after the clinic visit on 12/05/23
concerns.hazard: lack of medication monitoring after clinic visit

concerns.quote: barriers to the use of S2 and S3 of the Mental health Act due to AMPH resistance, administrative challenges and resourcing
Landlords have to rely on the information given to them by the residents and do not have access to other key information held by other agencies
support workers need more focussed training on mental health conditions and how to manage and help residents with enduring mental health conditions

links.explanation: Both reports highlight failures in monitoring and communicating medication-related information between healthcare providers. The earlier report cites missed carbamazepine prescribing due to poor specialist‑team communication, while the later report notes inadequate post‑clinic medication monitoring and investigation.
links.earlier_quote: the deceased went without his medication. The deceased's GP had to contact the community mental health team directly notwithstanding the psychiatric liaison nurse's involvement.
links.later_quote: Internal investigation: The internal investigation did not address how and whether the offender's use of medication should have been monitored after the clinic visit on 12/05/23.
